gueter.leer: The inventory is created when the game starts.
gueter.einleitung: The country covers {autark} of {gesamt} goods groups itself. For the rest it depends on supplier countries, sea lanes and pipelines.
gueter.jahr: Quantities per year; stocks and shortfalls are computed monthly.
gueter.beispiel: {name}: production about {produktion}, consumption about {verbrauch} {einheit}; grown in {orte}.
gueter.ruestungHinweis: Self-sufficiency in defence goods follows defence autonomy in the policy network; quantities and stocks are kept in the military file.
gueter.satz.fehl: {name}: Stocks are empty, about {fehl} % of monthly demand is missing. Prices are rising.
gueter.satz.lager: {name}: {anteil} % of imports are cut off; stocks still cover the gap.
gueter.satz.selbst: {name}: The country supplies itself; the surplus is exported.
gueter.satz.knapp: {name}: Self-sufficiency {autarkie} %, the rest comes from the world market.
gueter.wirkung.reserve: Buys one month of demand into stock. Costs money, protects against the next supply cut.
gueter.wirkung.freigabe: Releases one month of demand onto the market. Lowers the price once; the buffer shrinks.
gueter.wirkung.foerderung: A year of export credit and trade fairs: more exports and foreign currency, at a cost to the budget.
gueter.wirkung.stopp: Keeps the goods at home: prices fall, but buyers and exporters are annoyed.
gueter.wirkung.quelle: New supply contracts with other countries: cut-offs hit only half as hard, the goods get dearer.
gueter.grund.nicht: That is not possible right now.
gueter.erg.reserve: Strategic reserve of {name} topped up by one month of demand.
gueter.erg.freigabe: Reserve of {name} released; the market calms down.
gueter.erg.quelle: Imports of {name} spread across new supplier countries.
gueter.linse.ressourcen.hinweis: Strong colour means world rank. Among the neighbours: {ausland}.
gueter.linse.strategie.hinweis: Outside the country the key ones are: {orte}.
gueter.ampel.gruen: Stocks last more than three months without imports.
gueter.ampel.gelb: Without imports it gets tight within three months.
gueter.ampel.rot: Without imports stocks run out in under a month.
